en.title: HUD Rescinds Fair Housing Accessibility Rule, Impacting New U.S. Housing Compliance
en.summary: The U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development withdrew its ‘continuing violation’ interpretation of the Fair Housing Act’s design-and-construction accessibility requirements, altering compliance assessments for new housing. This change follows ongoing debates about accessibility standards and enforcement. Other notable developments include congressional calls for accessible housing, funding for Bellerose station accessibility upgrades, and upcoming AI accessibility solutions from Masats.

highlights.title: HUD issues new guidance, rescinds ‘continuing violation’ interpretation of Fair Housing Act design-and-construction accessibility requirements
Cannington, Rice: Congress must prioritize accessibility in housing supply
Bellerose station gets $250G to add elevator and ramps, the last Nassau LIRR facility to become accessible
Masats to Unveil AI-Powered Accessibility Solutions at FIAA 2026
LDF Condemns ABA Decision Repealing Standard 206 That Advanced Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Accessibility in Law Schools and the Legal Profession

zh-TW.title: HUD 撤銷公平住房無障礙解釋，影響新住宅合規評估
zh-TW.summary: 美國住房與城市發展部（HUD）撤銷了公平住房法設計與建築無障礙要求的‘持續違反’解釋，改變新住宅的合規評估方式。此舉引發對無障礙標準與執行的討論。其他重要發展包括國會議員呼籲優先考慮無障礙住房、貝勒羅斯車站獲得2.5億美元用於電梯與坡道設置，以及 Masats 將在 FIAA 2026 展出 AI 無障礙解決方案。

highlights.title: HUD發布新指引，撤銷對公平住房法設計與建築無障礙要求的‘持續違反’解釋
Cannington、Rice：國會必須將住房供應中的無障礙置於優先
貝勒羅斯車站獲得 2.5 億美元增設電梯與坡道，成為納蘇 LIRR 最後一個實現無障礙的設施
Masats 將在 FIAA 2026 展出 AI 驅動的無障礙解決方案
法律防衛基金會譴責美國律師協會廢止標準 206 的決定，該標準曾推動法學院與法律專業的多樣性、公平、包容及無障礙
